item.title: Colony trails King Street workspace
item.description: The flex office provider has shared images of its next Manchester location, where it will operate 44,000 sq ft from April. The post Colony trails King Street workspace appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Bellway moves ahead with Cronton Grey Belt pitch
item.description: Outline plans for 120 homes on 10.5 acres north of Cronton Road abutting the existing settlement have been put to Knowsley Council. The post Bellway moves ahead with Cronton Grey Belt pitch appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Post-fire Hotspur Press plans sail through Manchester committee
item.description: Less than 30 minutes were needed for Manner’s proposal for the site, 619 student flats over 35 storeys, to be approved unanimously. The post Post-fire Hotspur Press plans sail through Manchester committee appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM VIDEO | How to turn regeneration into inclusive growth
item.description: Overcoming barriers to delivery and speeding up planning, and taking a collegiate approach to risk management and other processes are just a few of the ways to ensuring projects can make both a difference and a profit, according to participants at a roundtable hosted by WSP. The post MIPIM VIDEO | How to turn regeneration into inclusive growth appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM | Rochdale: Co-operative by nature, pioneering by design
item.description: Mark Robinson, director of economy and place at Rochdale Council, and Richard Jones, Northern Cities Executive at Arcadis, discuss two major developments in the borough. The post MIPIM | Rochdale: Co-operative by nature, pioneering by design appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM | Salford at 100: the next 10 years of ambition
item.description: Stephen Young, Salford City Council chief executive, describes how Salford is a city transformed by a proven track record of major regeneration – bigger, younger, more diverse, and more dynamic than at any point in modern history. The post MIPIM | Salford at 100: the next 10 years of ambition appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM | Govt prepares to roll out £720m fund to unleash growth
item.description: The Office for Investment is targeting late spring to kick off the the Strategic Sites Accelerator, aimed at unlocking major schemes aligned with the government’s industrial strategy. item.title: MIPIM VIDEO | Industrial & Logistics: powerful opportunities

item.title: MIPIM GALLERY | Investable North
item.description: From marinas to innovation districts, Northern leaders pitched £500m investment visions for their regions at this Dragons Den-style event. The post MIPIM GALLERY | Investable North appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM GALLERY | Edge of opportunity: Unlocking growth through regeneration at the urban fringe
item.description: There may be no simple solution for resolving viability issues, but with enough grit, determination, and creative thinking it is possible to move the needle on housing delivery – that was the consensus from an engaging MIPIM session on Thursday hosted by WSP on the North of England Suite.
